same_cell_repetition.decision: One attestation per distinct NFC transcription within the same numbered prompt and site; retain all segment positions and similarity-group labels in audit.

multiple_distinct_responses.decision: Emit separate attested responses without variant/cognacy edges. Similarity codes do not establish a lexical relation.
multiple_distinct_responses.paired_prompt_decision: Preserve the complete printed prompt for every response, including single-response cells. Do not assign a response to imperative/past/present/negative solely by its sequence or similarity code.
multiple_distinct_responses.review_note: Paired English prompts do not establish unambiguous response-to-slot mapping; full prompt retained.

pronouns.decision: Prompt person/number/gender/inclusivity/register distinctions can be represented as tags. Keep source prompt in audit and do not deduplicate across prompt IDs.
